# BB00456 {.unnumbered}

He is the Truth! There is no God but Him and all bow down before Him.

O Name of God, the Most Generous! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Ancient King. After greetings, 9 parts have been sent with Al-Azim, 4. Let the haykals be written from these or in the manner of the connected haykal, for it has the strongest effect therein. You desire not what has already been revealed to you before, for it is indeed an ancient and true Book. And glorify all the people of guidance together.

And verily what ought to be manifested is that which is manifest above all things, and hidden beneath all things, and first before all things, and last on the right of all things, and dominant on the left of all things, according to what is in the traditions concerning the age of thirty. And verily from the first descent of the water of His being until the time He spoke the number of Ta and Kaf, and We have not made thee aware of it, and from an ancient living soul the letter of peace, and it has been fulfilled according to what the pure Family of God have informed after peace, the cycle of fire. Let them speak to those who believed before all worlds and to those around him at the time when "He answers the distressed when they call upon Him." So answer him who calls you from around the shrine, and be not content until a thousand after peace is completed. That is to be calculated from the first water of His being, and if calculated from the first manifestation of His body, subtract nine months and nine days.

So watch for what the witnesses of God have informed you beforehand, for when the month of Mim first rises, peace will be completed in the matter of calculation that you outwardly reckon, while inwardly it has been fulfilled, and in the inmost inward it has been fulfilled around, then the number of the name Muhammad. So watch your days and be victorious through God, your Lord, for those in whose hearts is the power of exposition, these are they who have power over all things by God's leave—He Who created all things by His command. Nothing in the heavens or on earth or between them can frustrate Him. Verily, He has power over all things.
